lead: Better blood flow, in two capsules. A targeted blend of L-citrulline and L-arginine — the amino acids your body turns into nitric oxide — to widen blood vessels, boost circulation and support the pump, stamina and vascular health.

science.title: How nitric oxide opens you up
science.text: Nitric oxide tells your blood vessels to relax and widen — so more oxygen and nutrients reach your muscles. We pair L-citrulline DL-malate with two forms of L-arginine, the amino acids your body converts into nitric oxide, to support circulation, the pump and vascular health from the inside out.

format.title: Two amino acids, one job
format.text: No proprietary fluff — just L-citrulline and L-arginine in clean vegetable capsules, dosed to support nitric oxide production. Take two before training or daily for circulation.
list: — 2 capsules = 400 mg citrulline + 400 mg arginine blend

absorb.title: More nitric oxide, more flow
absorb.lead: L-citrulline and L-arginine feed the nitric-oxide pathway, signalling blood vessels to widen so blood, oxygen and nutrients move more freely.

points.title: L-citrulline
points.text: Converts to arginine in the body for a longer, steadier rise in nitric oxide than arginine alone.

points.title: Dual L-arginine
points.text: Hydrochloride and alpha-ketoglutarate forms for a direct nitric-oxide boost and the muscle pump.

points.title: Vascular support
points.text: Wider, more relaxed blood vessels support circulation and everyday vascular health.

ingredients.title: Three nitric-oxide actives
ingredients.lead: L-citrulline and two forms of L-arginine to fuel nitric oxide.*

items.name: L-Citrulline DL-Malate
items.text: Converts to arginine for a longer, steadier rise in nitric oxide — plus malate for stamina and reduced fatigue.

items.name: L-Arginine HCl
items.text: A direct nitric-oxide precursor that signals blood vessels to relax and widen for better flow.

items.name: L-Arginine AKG
items.text: An absorbable form of arginine prized in pre-workouts for supporting the muscle pump.

facts.other: Other Ingredients: Cellulose (vegetable capsule), Brown Rice Flour.
facts.side_text: 400 mg L-citrulline DL-malate, 350 mg L-arginine HCl and 50 mg L-arginine alpha-ketoglutarate, in a vegetable capsule with brown rice flour. No stimulants, no fillers. Made in the USA — 60 capsules.
facts.warning: Not for use by those with low blood pressure or on blood-pressure or erectile-dysfunction medication, pregnant or nursing women, or anyone under 18. Consult a physician if you have a medical condition.

steps.title: Two capsules with water
steps.text: Take 2 capsules with 6–8 oz of water — the label's recommended serving.

steps.title: 30–45 min pre-workout
steps.text: For the pump, take them about 30–45 minutes before training so nitric oxide peaks as you start.

steps.title: Or daily for circulation
steps.text: Prefer everyday vascular support? Take them at the same time each day, consistently.

series.label: Pump
series.title: Fuller pumps, faster
series.text: Nitric-oxide precursors were associated with noticeably bigger, longer-lasting pumps during training.

series.label: Endurance
series.title: Go longer before you fade
series.text: Better blood flow means more oxygen to muscles — people tracked improved endurance and later fatigue.

series.label: Circulation
series.title: Flow that supports recovery
series.text: Improved circulation supports nutrient delivery and a smoother recovery between sessions.

items.a: It signals your blood vessels to relax and widen, so blood, oxygen and nutrients flow more freely — supporting the pump, endurance and vascular health.
Citrulline gives a longer, steadier nitric-oxide rise, while arginine gives a more direct boost. Together they cover both for better, more sustained flow.
About 30–45 minutes before training for the pump, or daily at a consistent time for everyday circulation support.
No — it's stimulant-free, so it won't keep you up and pairs well with a separate caffeine source if you want one.
